title: centaurea ramosa
intro: Centaurea ramosa, commonly known as Ramsted's knapweed, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Centaurea ramosa include its potential to treat inflammation, reduce pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea ramosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
